title: Ad copy
detail: MASTER THE LOOP. STEAL FIRST. / Race Now

what: Zapwick Rush: Unity players can chase mastery in Zapwick Rush on PC or browser, timing electric dashes and careful shots to seize the lead through towering loops and glowing hover sections. The game is a kart racing game: show karts racing on a track with loops, twists, glowing hover sections, never people on foot, motorbikes or cars. The kart: One low-poly kart body with a broad wedge nose, rounded side pods, a recessed bucket seat and a short rear fin. Use glossy paint tinted to the assigned kart color, cream nose stripes, charcoal seat padding and brushed silver trim; include no driver and no wheels., in colours like #ff593e, #28cfff, #ffe047. The rider sitting in it: One low-poly humanoid figure in a seated pose with both arms reaching forward, with no vehicle. Use warm brown skin, a cyan padded suit, yellow lightning-shaped chest trim, oversized charcoal gloves and a rounded cyan helmet with a solid yellow crest; materials are matte fabric, rubber and glossy pa. Humanoid riders have large padded gloves, rounded helmets and expressive faces. Keep class clothing clearly visible above the kart body.. Sky #87dfff, ground #70cf79; a bright, chunky, toy-like 3D game look. An advertising key visual for Unity players: bold, bright, one clear subject, room at the top for a headline. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark. No pink or magenta.
